quotes.text: We start out by finding the balance on our toe
It requires some knee stretching But try to keep 50% weight on each leg
To help learn the balance of the trick You can use a chair
When you feel safe let out, And straighthen up
Now We add the pop and lock our legs Keep the dragin the heel across to keep spining
